text:
maru: Quick post-mortem from the v4-small PTQ runs: NDCG@10 is essentially no change (+0.001) but MRR@5 on the short-query cohort dropped ~4.1%.

anya: same pattern we've seen before. Did you check candidate slot stability and metric ordering?

maru: Yup. Loader preserved snapshot order, but our metric pipeline uses np.argsort on float32 scores and then a pure-Python stable sort for ties. Suspect quant bins are creating many near-equal scores around rank-1.

dmitri: PTQ can compress logits into fewer representable bins. That increases exact-equal and near-equal counts; MRR (sensitive to position) moves more than NDCG@10.

carmen: Can you share summary stats (exact ties, <1e-4 deltas, top-k delta hist)?

maru: Paste of the summary: 
- top-3 exact-equal counts: FP32: 0.08% queries, PTQ: 1.9%
- top-3 delta <1e-4: FP32: 0.7%, PTQ: 6.1%
- mean abs delta (top1..3): FP32 3.5e-3, PTQ 2.8e-3 (var compressed)

zack: Two short-term options: (A) deterministic tiebreaker by candidate_id in the final rank step; (B) keep final-layer logits in higher precision (fp16) or apply tiny deterministic offset from candidate_id hash. Prefer (A) for determinism.

maru: Ran small reproducer with three configs (seeded):
1) no-shuffle + stable tiebreak (id) => MRR@5 gap -0.9%
2) no-shuffle + stable tiebreak top-3 => MRR@3 gap -4.0%
3) last-layer fp16 + tie-break => MRR@3 gap -0.5%
So tiebreaker helps a lot and last-layer fp16 closes the rest.

dmitri: Good. We should instrument the harness to export a "topk_exact_ties" metric and a score-resolution metric (e.g., fraction of deltas < 1e-4 at p50/p95).

carmen: Also note: numpy.argsort stability depends on version and kind='stable' option. For safety, use sorted(...) stable tie-breaker in Python or np.lexsort with explicit secondary key. Document the reason in the eval harness docstring.

maru: Plan:
- short PR to add deterministic tiebreaker shim in eval + prod ranker (stable by candidate_id)
- add smoke in rankbench: run PTQ on short-query cohort and assert MRR@5 drop <= 1%
- add offline metrics: topk_exact_ties, tiny-delta-fraction, and include histograms as artifacts in CI
- optional: config knob to keep last-layer fp16 for problematic quant schemes
I'll open PR with artifacts (histograms + seed logs) and a follow-up INF issue.

ci-bot: build-1402: artifacts uploaded -> https://ci.redwood/job/1402/artifacts (histograms + seed manifest).

ops-bot: issue-bot: created INF-8402 "PTQ: short-query MRR regression due to quant tie clustering; add tiebreaker + score-res metrics" assigned to maru.

anya: LGTM. Please add the rankbench smoke and tag me on the PR. Also add a note in the deploy runbook about when to enable last-layer-fp16 fallback.

maru: Will do. Thanks everyone.
